thread:
elaine: saw a tiny burst of duplicate connections in the console for EU shards. looks like clients reconnecting with resume tokens but landing on a different shard. logs: ```INFO sse: resume_token=true prev_shard=sh-2 new_shard=sh-7 allocated_new_session=true tenant=acorn client_id=svc-22```
peter: billing OK?
elaine: billing pipeline shows no double charges. it's just the active_session count upstream and our alert fired briefly.
sree: sounds like a resume-vs-fresh ambiguity. runtime creates new session if shard can't attach token. console treats new session id as independent. we should emit a low-cardinality metric outcome={resume,accepted,fallback} and a tiny sampled diagnostic when token+new_session combo happens.
peter: agree. keep metric tags minimal: outcome + region only. avoid tenant to control cardinality.
elaine: console short-term UX idea: show a faint "resumed" badge when token presented AND last_seen < 18s. tooltip: "Client reattached using resume token; routing fallback created a new backend session. This does not indicate double billing." behind a FF to avoid NAT mislabels.
sree: also add a 1% sampled trace including prev_shard and new_shard and a reason code. payload must be tiny.
infra-bot: alert suppressed: sse.duplicate_sessions at 2026-04-01T09:03:10Z
peter: rollout: telemetry canary 5% tenants tomorrow 08:00 UTC, console FF for internal tenants after telemetry looks stable. adjust alert to ignore dup spikes when resume_ratio>0.45 in 1m window.
elaine: will open PLAT-9999 and link telem + UI + alert PRs. sree: please keep diag sampling low.
sree: on it, PR incoming. console-bot: ticket PLAT-9999 created and assigned to elaine, peter, sree
